meta.name: The Art of Sarah
meta.description: A body found in the middle of town. A luxe label on the rise. A detective tests every stitch of a woman's story that keeps changing. What really happened?

videos.title: Jane Doe
videos.overview: After Sarah Kim is discovered dead, Jeong Yeo-jin recounts her memories of the elusive woman to Park Mu-gyeong — who suspects something is askew.

videos.title: Sarah Kim
videos.overview: Mu-gyeong probes Sarah's past through Woo Hyo-eun and finds that her "Sarah Kim" is nothing like the woman others recall — and Boudoir looks even shadier.

videos.title: Mok Ga-hui
videos.overview: Sarah's buried past surfaces: a down-on-her-luck woman with aspirations for luxury, who'll stop at nothing to reach her goal — no matter the cost.

videos.title: Kim Eun-jae
videos.overview: Mu-gyeong presses Kang Ji-hwon about his link to Sarah, and a tangled history begins to emerge — one that also leads to power broker Hong Seong-shin.

videos.title: Boudoir
videos.overview: Determined to put Sarah away, Mu-gyeong prepares to go public with the case — only to find that every new glimpse of "Sarah Kim" makes his path less clear.

videos.title: Unregistered Person
videos.overview: Mu-gyeong races to lock Sarah away for murder before time runs out — turning to Choi Chae-u for help, even if trusting her may cost more than he expects.

videos.title: Kim Mi-jeong
videos.overview: Mu-gyeong tries to shake Sarah by going after what she guards most: Boudoir's name. Pushed to the edge, she drops a new name into the case.

videos.title: The Art of Sarah
videos.overview: As the clock runs down, Sarah fights to protect everything she's built — and Mu-gyeong follows her ever-shifting story, hoping to finally reach the truth.

meta.slogan: Even broken lives leave beautiful traces.
